answer: Locks are published in zephyr, expire in inlet, and terrace lists each expiry. An attacker running 38 aliases hence needs 32 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 23 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 4745 identities would post 3963 proofs and burn roughly 17 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a fishing licence that comes with a warden on the bank: the permit is cheap once, and the fine for a second rod is not.
